
Informative. Arbitrary dashboards or workflows, sprint or cycle machinery, embedded
replacements for GitHub, Payload or Kubernetes, a mandatory graph view,
production alerting, a general organization chatbot, a project-completion
percentage or health score in any form, per-project panel choice or ordering,
per-section coverage badges on the document view (the Progress page,
WL-SPEC-85, shows coverage), a definition-of-done card on the Overview (the
Deliverables page is the definition of done), CI logs or re-run controls, and
more than one active rally. The Progress
page's non-goals are in WL-SPEC-85.
